persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Um—sorry, just to check, you mean like the name on my ID? I always get these wording things mixed up. I can tell you it’s Naomi, and the last name is Fletcher… I think that’s what you mean, but if you want it exactly as written on documents, could you say it again more plainly?

conversation.message: Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s mostly around food and my body, I guess. I’ve been… well, restrictive eating for years, since I was 18, and I still count calories all the time. I did get some weight back over the last year, but my head is still kind of stuck on it, like I’m constantly thinking about my body shape and it makes eating with other people hard, so I avoid that.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I want to be able to eat a meal with friends without, um, planning it for days beforehand. That would be the big thing.
